query: PREFIX dkg-cti: [http://dkg.cybersec.org/cti#](http://dkg.cybersec.org/cti#) SELECT ?cve WHERE { ?cve a dkg-cti:Vulnerability . }
PREFIX skos: [http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#](http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#) SELECT ?concept ?label WHERE { ?concept a skos:Concept ; skos:prefLabel ?label . }
PREFIX dkg: [http://dkg.cybersec.org/tbox#](http://dkg.cybersec.org/tbox#) SELECT ?asset WHERE { ?asset a dkg:HighRiskAsset . }
